text:
Predicates:
BrownSwiss(x) ::: x is a Brown Swiss cattle.
Cow(x) ::: x is a cow.
Pet(x) ::: x is a pet.
Domesticated(x) ::: x is a domesticated animal.
Alligator(x) ::: x is an alligator.
Premises:
∀x (BrownSwiss(x) → Cow(x)) ::: All Brown Swiss cattle are cows.
∃x (Pet(x) ∧ BrownSwiss(x)) ::: Some pets are Brown Swiss cattle.
∀x (Cow(x) → Domesticated(x)) ::: All cows are domesticated animals.
∀x (Alligator(x) → ¬Domesticated(x)) ::: Alligators are not domesticated animals.
Alligator(ted) ::: Ted is an alligator.
Conclusion:
¬(Pet(ted) ∧ BrownSwiss(ted)) ::: Ted is not a pet and Brown Swiss cattle.
